intro.title: What is Watchborne?
intro.description: Watchborne is an OCPP monitoring platform built for EV charging station installers. It centralizes the status of every charger, across every site, in a single real-time dashboard — so you always know what's happening in the field, without driving out or waiting for a customer call.

workflow.title: Time saved at every step
workflow.subtitle: From commissioning to customer support, Watchborne supports the whole lifecycle of your charging stations.

installation.title: Commissioning
installation.description: Track commissioning through a dedicated queue and checklist, and self-generate an OCPP commissioning token without waiting on support.

monitoring.title: Daily supervision
monitoring.description: Keep a real-time eye on the connection status, consumption, and firmware updates of your whole fleet, across sites, from a single screen.

maintenance.title: Maintenance & intervention
maintenance.description: Catch disconnections, faults, and failed firmware updates before your customers do with automatic alerts, and prioritize field interventions accordingly.

reporting.title: Customer reporting
reporting.description: Give your customers reliable visibility into their charger availability and consumption, without manual reporting.

connection.title: Connect a charge point to Watchborne
connection.description: For a charge point to report its status in Watchborne, it needs to connect to our OCPP server. Enter the address below in the charge point's OCPP settings, then suffix it with the charge point's unique identifier.

steps.openSettings: Open the charge point's OCPP settings (sometimes called the "Central System URL"), usually found in its admin interface.
steps.enterAddress: Enter the OCPP server address above.
steps.appendId: Suffix the address with the charge point's unique identifier, for example: {example}
steps.restart: Save and restart the charge point: it will appear in Watchborne as soon as it first connects.

commissioningToken.title: Personal commissioning token
commissioningToken.description: Generate a personal token and add it as a `token` query parameter to the OCPP server address configured on your charge points. Any charge point that connects for the first time with this token is automatically linked to your account, with no extra manual step.
commissioningToken.revealedWarning: Copy this token now — it will never be shown in full again.

regenerateConfirm.title: Regenerate the token?
regenerateConfirm.description: The current token will stop working immediately. Charge points already commissioned aren't affected; only auto-commissioning new charge points with the old token will stop working.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke the token?
revokeConfirm.description: The current token will stop working immediately and won't be replaced with a new one. Charge points already commissioned aren't affected — this only stops auto-commissioning new charge points with it.

association.title: Commission a charge point
association.description: A charge point connecting for the first time is automatically discovered and appears in the "Awaiting commissioning" queue at the top of the "Charge Points" page. Click "Commission" to rename it and attach it to a site in one step. You can also change this association later from the charge point's form. A charge point can only be attached to one site at a time.
